counterfactual_missing_items: No raw span showing response to antibiotics; swelling and redness persisted despite cefaclor.
No raw span showing fever, leukocytosis, or markedly elevated CRP; CRP was only 0.59 mg/dL.
No raw span showing LCH-specific findings such as beveled/punched-out bone edges, diabetes insipidus, or alveolar/teeth involvement; maxillary alveolar processes and teeth were intact.
response.rationale: R5 is the only candidate whose raw spans cover the full aggressive imaging phenotype: destructive maxillary lesion with soft-tissue mass, fluid-fluid level, heterogeneous enhancement, and rapid enlargement. R3/C1 share only the destructive maxillary location and T2 hyperintensity, lacking the discriminating fluid-fluid level and rapid growth; R4 is contradicted by persistence despite antibiotics and destructive imaging; R2 is a less likely sarcoma subtype without site/age-specific raw support.

rejected.why: Redundant append-only completion of R3; no independent raw span beyond the shared destructive maxillary lesion; discounted as correlated restatement.
Ewing sarcoma is not specifically supported by raw spans; the same destructive/rapid-enlargement features are nonspecific and Ewing is less typical for this sinonasal/orbital toddler presentation.
Only superficial periorbital swelling and erythema are raw-supported; the destructive lesion, lack of response to cefaclor, and normal CRP argue strongly against cellulitis.
